{{Top|leg}}
'''T8''' was a location at which some [[Mining/Legends|mines]] were situated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{RPG}}
After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Night Forael Wren|Night Wren]] was captured by the [[Thaereian military]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;set out to travel to [[Thaere Privo]] and rescue her. They disguised themselves as Thaereians and en route they stopped over at the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[T-4]], and for a [[Time/Legends|time]], it seemed to the agents that the Thaereian workers they were traveling among were going to be transported to the mines at T8.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
T8 features in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] module ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'', and is mentioned in a narrative section that relates to a possible way by which the player characters can travel to Thaere Privo. The scenario does not reveal the nature of what T8 is.
